comparison.objective: Thread four handed propellers onto matching motors, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Thread engagement, handed rotation, and seating torque overlap with controlled rotary tightening, but no separate unlock-adjust-lock sequence or response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: All hubs sit tight on their motor bells; torque, thread-depth, cross-thread, and damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests repeated handed-thread assembly; the candidate tests tuning a dissipative component from observed dynamics.
